source.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: a wide 16:9 stage painting for Cithaeron Slopes in the Bacchae chapter of the Wine-Dark Sea card game.
Input images: image 1 is a style reference for richly painted Greek trees, paths and natural light. Image 2 is a style reference for rugged Greek limestone, depth and mountain terrain. Compose a new living woodland setting.
Primary request: a rugged wooded slope on Mount Cithaeron above Thebes. Goat paths cross among old holm oaks, tall firs and pines, limestone outcrops, ivy, dry grasses and low mountain shrubs. A rough path climbs between trees toward the ridge; another path bends downhill toward a small distant glimpse of the Theban valley. A tall fir stands beside the uphill path. A few ivy branches and a simple wool ribbon tied around a small stone at the edge suggest a place visited by the worshippers.
Composition: eye level, wide 16:9. Place the rugged trees and boulders mainly at the sides and in the middle distance. Keep a broad clear rock-and-earth clearing across the lower third for separate cast portraits. The uphill path, wooded slope and limestone ridge stay readable in the center phone crop. Natural landscape and its small ritual marker fill the scene.
Style: match the game's detailed painterly Greek storybook realism, weathered bark, rough stone, layered foliage and rich natural textures. Mossy and olive greens, warm pale rock, muted earth and a little blue distance.
Lighting: clear afternoon daylight through the trees, warm highlights and cool green shadows. Quiet mountain air, with a sense of hidden depth beyond the clearing. Opaque full-frame scenery.

source.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: a wide 16:9 stage painting of the Palace of Pherae for the Alcestis chapter in the Wine-Dark Sea card game.
Input images: style references for detailed Greek painted architecture, natural light, aged stone and a broad foreground. Compose a distinct Thessalian palace household.
Scene: a quiet royal court at Pherae. A broad low palace portico has pale limestone columns, soft blue-grey and ochre painted borders, tall wooden inner doors and a little trailing vine. One simple empty wooden chair stands in the shade near the main doorway, slightly left of center. A plain bench and a small unlit oil lamp sit along the wall. The house feels dignified and restrained, with the stillness of a household in mourning. Through a side opening, a green Thessalian plain and distant blue mountain ridge are visible.
Composition: eye-level wide 16:9. Keep the main doorway and empty chair readable together in the central phone crop. Leave a generous open limestone court across the lower third for separate cast portraits. The palace architecture and landscape fill the frame.
Style and light: richly detailed Greek storybook realism, pale weathered stone, natural wood, muted woven cloth and cool blue-grey accents. Clear warm afternoon daylight with soft portico shadows and dry calm air. Opaque full-frame painting.

source.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: a wide 16:9 stage painting of the House at Trachis for the Women of Trachis chapter in the Wine-Dark Sea card game.
Input image: a style reference for detailed Greek domestic painting, warm plaster, timber, cloth and open foreground. Compose a distinct household at the foot of wooded mountain slopes.
Scene: a modest, well-kept Greek house around a quiet open court. A long low cream-plastered facade has a red tile roof, simple timber porch posts and a main wooden doorway near the center. A plain wooden workbench immediately beside the doorway holds a neatly folded length of undyed wool. A pair of worn messenger's sandals rests by the threshold. A small unlit hanging oil lamp is beneath the porch. Vines and an olive tree frame the sides; clay jars, a low bench and household plants sit by the walls. Beyond one side of the court, a path turns toward the wooded slopes and pale ridges leading toward Oeta.
Composition: eye-level wide 16:9. Keep the house doorway, workbench and folded cloth together in the central phone crop. Leave the lower third as clear stone-and-earth court for separate cast portraits. Architecture and landscape fill the frame.
Style and light: richly detailed Greek storybook realism, weathered warm plaster, ochre earth, natural timber, muted woven cloth, olive green and blue mountain distance. Clear afternoon daylight with soft vine shadows and dry calm air. Opaque full-frame painting.

source.prompt: Use case: historical game scenery. Paint one wide 16:9 CosyWorld backdrop in a rich hand-painted storybook style with detailed stone, warm light, deep space and a clear central foreground for character portraits. Show the Achaemenid court at ancient Susa in 480 BCE: a broad limestone courtyard, tall slender columns with paired bull capitals, blue and turquoise glazed brick friezes, a distant monumental hypostyle hall, low offering stone and royal tomb enclosure at the left, and a shaded palace threshold at the right. Pale ochre and turquoise, date palms, distant dry foothills, clear afternoon sky. The central paved court is empty and readable in a narrow phone crop. This is a Persian royal court; use Achaemenid architecture. Pure scenery, empty court, no people, ships, writing, captions, borders or game UI.

source.name: tauris-shore-day
source.prompt:
Use case: historical-scene.
Asset type: native painted background scene for CosyWorld's Greek drama card game.
Input images: references for the established warm painted Greek storybook style, natural stone, coastal water and architectural scale. Create the new place specified below.
Style/medium: finely detailed painterly storybook realism, hand-painted stone and nature, natural daylight, restrained warm earth and blue pigments, soft depth and readable landmarks.
Composition/framing: one wide native landscape PNG, about 1536 by 1024. Eye-level wide establishing camera. Keep the central vertical strip useful when the wide painting is cropped into a 390 by 580 phone view. Place key location landmarks within that centre area. The bottom third is broad clear, nearly level stone or earth ground for the game's separate full-body cast and carried objects. Build location details toward the middle distance and edges. Only the place's architecture, natural landscape and water occupy this environment painting.
Lighting: clear natural daytime with soft warm sunlight and readable stone shadows. This is the daylight base for an exact-camera night sibling.
Output: complete opaque native PNG, with the entire original generated canvas preserved.
Place: the Taurian Shore, a rocky coast below a Greek-style coastal temple. Broad worn temple steps descend from a modest pale stone portico in the upper left toward the shore. A clear accessible stone landing projects gently into a sheltered inlet at centre-right. The lower third is broad nearly level stone and sandy shore for Thoas, a traveller and carried objects. Sea water is clearly visible across the middle, especially inside the central phone crop. Coastal rocks frame the inlet and a distant dark headland closes the far horizon. The berth beside the landing faces clear open water. This is the open-berth view. Keep the temple steps, landing, inlet water, headland and rock shapes as strong stable landmarks. Place the landing near enough to the central crop that a later moored ship will read at phone width while the water remains visible. Only the shore, temple architecture, landing, rocks, sea and sky occupy the image. This place reads as being on the Taurian Shore.
